$$W = C - \frac{7}{(20)} \times (80 - P)$$

The formula shown can be used to approximate the apparent temperature $W$, in degrees Celsius, given the actual air temperature $C$, in degrees Celsius, and the cloud cover of $P$ percent, where $P > 40$. Which of the following expresses the cloud cover in terms of the actual air temperature and the apparent temperature?
explanation: Choice D is correct. It's given that $W = C - \frac{7}{20} \times (80 - P)$. Solving this formula for $P$ expresses the cloud cover in terms of the actual air temperature and the apparent temperature. Subtracting $C$ from both sides yields $W - C = -\frac{7}{20} \times (80 - P)$. Multiplying both sides by $-\frac{20}{7}$ yields $-\frac{20}{7} \times (W - C) = 80 - P$. Subtracting $80$ from both sides yields $-\frac{20}{7} \times (W - C) - 80 = -P$. Multiplying both sides by $-1$ results in the formula $P = \frac{20}{7} \times (W - C) + 80$.
